func work(_ item: Int) async {}

final class Runner {
  var items: [Int] = []
  var tasks: [Task<Void, Never>] = []

  // CASE task_priority_operation_plain expect=pass
  func a() {
    for item in items {
      tasks.append(Task(priority: .high, operation: { await work(item) }))
    }
  }

  // CASE detached_operation_capture expect=pass
  func b() {
    for item in items {
      tasks.append(Task.detached(priority: .high, operation: { [weak self] in
        await self?.go(item)
      }))
    }
  }

  // CASE task_operation_plain_bare expect=pass
  func c() {
    for item in items {
      Task(operation: { await work(item) })
    }
  }

  // CASE task_trailing_after_label expect=pass
  func d() {
    for item in items {
      Task(priority: .low) { @MainActor [weak self] in
        await self?.go(item)
      }
    }
  }

  func go(_ item: Int) async {}
}
